column1: # mapping_set_title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 to NIST OSCAL Mappings

# mapping_set_description: Schema-level mappings between ISO/IEC 27001:2022 ISMS LinkML classes and NIST OSCAL (Open Security Controls Assessment Language) document model classes. OSCAL is the highest-priority interop target identified in iso27001/VALUE.md; mappings here cover the catalog, profile, system-security-plan (SSP), assessment-plan, assessment-results and POA&M layers. Predicates - skos:closeMatch where ISO27001 and OSCAL classes model the same governance artefact at comparable granularity; skos:relatedMatch where the OSCAL concept is OSCAL-specific (e.g. Party, Role, ResponsibleParty) and only partially overlaps; skos:broadMatch where the OSCAL document type subsumes multiple ISO 27001 entities.

column10: comment
OSCAL SSP is the closest OSCAL artefact to an ISMS root container
OSCAL Control corresponds to Annex A control instance
SoA aggregate corresponds to OSCAL SSP control-implementation block
Per-control SoA entry corresponds to OSCAL implemented-requirement
Risk treatment plan is analogous to OSCAL POA&M document
Corrective action corresponds to a POA&M item
Nonconformity corresponds to an OSCAL POA&M related finding
Internal audit corresponds to OSCAL assessment plan instance
Audit programme schedules multiple OSCAL assessment plans
Audit finding corresponds to OSCAL related-finding entry
Both define an organisational role with responsibilities and authorities
OSCAL Party with party-type organisation corresponds to ISO 27001 Organization
Interested party with assigned role aligns with OSCAL responsible-party concept
ISMS asset corresponds to OSCAL SSP inventory item
OSCAL document base aligns with documented-information abstraction
Risk assessment is partially analogous to OSCAL assessment-plan/results pair
Operational procedure aligns with OSCAL assessment-plan activity
Incident-triggered remediation aligns with POA&M item lifecycle
Competence record describes a party's qualifications
Control identifier slot points at the OSCAL Control entity
Implementation status enumeration aligns with OSCAL implementation-status object
